test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 Oct 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is India's first AI-based job platform for persons with disabilities?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Swarajability**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Swarajability, India's first AI-based job portal for persons with disabilities, has been launched to widen their opportunities with tech applications.
 
• The platform aids people with disabilities like visual, hearing impairment, and locomotive disorders in seeking employment.
 
• IIT-Hyderabad provided expertise for the Artificial Intelligence component.
 
• The project is funded by Kotak Mahindra Bank.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• It is developed in both web and mobile app versions for maximum reach.
 
• Visual Quest India is the developer and Youth4Jobs offered its experience in skilling, disability, and job linkages.
 
• It is a one-stop-shop for organisations that want to hire persons with disabilities.
 
• Also, it supports NGOs, educational institutions, and governments in their efforts to promote diversity and inclusion.
